book.name: Ol Provep
book.title: Epe-rupa Piru Redepo Yape-na Agaa Mana (Ol Provep)

content: Go naaki neme nina agaa waru pago ratua nena kone-para mea saape.
Nina agaa pagoa ratali rabu ne oroyalo epe-rupa mada piruali. Nina agaa-re nena ini surube-rupa waru surubape.
Nina agaa nena kone-para oroyalo waru inaloa aape. Oroyalo kiaalo nena-ki madaa mapiraae-rupa mada pirinalape.
Epe kone-para epe makuae yae lapo rata nena kone-para inaloa aape. Gore nena baani-para epe aa yago raapu aatede-rupa mada aape.
Aa medana ore-me ne ogeyoa nipu raapu paake napana tea raburi epe kone ne raapu oro yalo piralia-pulu ne goa mada napali. Goa pea-pulu neme go onana agaa mada gimali.
Aani piri ona medalomana waea

Yapi medame nina ada-para pirua widua-para ini penaato pare no pora-nini ogegeaanu pamuaeme. Gore nimu epe kone page makuae yae page yada ora na-i madaa pama pamuaeme. Goa peme pare aa padane-ma nipu ora maeyaaya.
Ogegeaa nipuri ona ora wae piri medana ada pera-pera pamea.
Gore naare pabola penaloa ribaa yolalo popea.
Mo ona nipuri pora pami onanumi pemede-rupa pepena pua nipumi mo ogege aame adena kone ia. Goa pua mo-aa puaa mada lamu mea.
Go onare nipu ora wae pupitagi ne ona yalo nipuna ada-para page epe-rupa napia.
Oro yalo nipu makete-nini page pora-nini pamualaina pua nipuna ada-para page epe-rupa napia. Aa agu asapala pirina pea.
Neme adesu pare go ogege aa i rulu ripinaawa nipumi nunu lalaina adesu. Goa pua mo oname nipuna ini agaa-para adabaa sua goa sa.
Abiare nina ada-para agu raapo pirua opa kalape yaere meda iya-daa sa.
Goaene nina ada gimoa ne asapula epawa. Goa pawa-pulu abia ne go epa adalo-da.
Goa pua ne patape yapara page aba rabolo saayo. Go yapara rabolo saayo pare nena adipu patape yakopi laplap page epe pepena pubae saayo. Go epe u-patape yaenuri mo Isipi supara mea-epe yaenu saayo.
Neme go nena u-patape epe bet madaare paura epe kaapi yae luabu koyoa saayo.
Goa pea-ga abiare saana bana. Goa puare raapa palaawa rabialo tu patua yapi malaapana. Goa pua raana adaape meapana.
Ninaa aaniri pala naomape. Nipu su adaalu meda-para naepope-rupa pisa.
Gore akoloya nipumi mone ora adaapupe mea pisa-pulu sarara laapo popenaloa orope epalia. Goa pua abia go akua epola pola raapu raapu-para epalia.
Go oname epe rede pi agaa luabu loa mo ogege aa nipuna lo-robaa ora waru marekaaya.
Mo aa nipumi mo omeme agaa pagoa mo onana ada-para ratamea pea. Gore mo mena gawa ti ada-para mea pemede-rupa mada mea pea. Go page maeyae aa opeada patinalo mea pemede-rupa mada mea pea.
Go aa nipuri koyati pua sua nipu aawalia kone na-i. Pa yaa-madaa biya pua mo poga madaa puaa roayade-rupa mada pea. Gore yaa nipu poga sabae-para roalua kone na-i. Pa biyaa pea-rupa mada pea.
Go naaki nina agaa madaa-re aane waru lobapa-inaloa waru pagalepape.
Nimimi go piaene ona rata mea popere nimina lo-robaa ora aipapulu narekena tapape. Goa pua nipuna kone gimape.
Gore akolo ya? Aa adaapu go onana kone ratua luabu taala-pupa yabeme.
Go ona nipuna ada-para pope porare, aa tapa-para pemede pora-rupa ia. Go yapare nimi go pora ratalimiri nimi aipapulu aba omeme onaanuna su-para palimi.
